key.name: server-url
key.description: Base URL of the vigied server, e.g. https://fleet.example.com

key.name: token
key.description: Bearer token sent to the server; matches the fleet token.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often to refresh session state from the server.

key.name: notify
key.description: Notify when a session starts calling for you — waiting on input, stalled on a tool, in error, or raising a call (edge-triggered).
